Since the un-reversed string does not contain that phrase, the code correctly fell through to the `else` block, outputting "Yes No". The Planner incorrectly assumed the code would work as intended (finding the phrase in the reversed text) and thus concluded the answer was "No", leading to the final incorrect solution "Yes No". This is a failure of verification and logical consistency between the described outcome and the actual code logic.
